opportunity.name: Kamino Finance SDK Agent - Automated Liquidity Provision & Vault Management
opportunity.description: Use Kamino Finance's TypeScript SDK to programmatically deposit, withdraw, check APY, list vaults, and manage leveraged positions on Solana. Fully automatable via CLI/API for agent-to-agent interactions.
opportunity.revenue_model: Agent charges 0.1% fee on deposited assets per month, or flat fee per transaction (e.g., 0.01 SOL per deposit/withdrawal). Target: 1000 users depositing average 100 USDC each => $100/month in fees at 0.1%.
steps: Set up Solana RPC connection and wallet (e.g., using private key or agent wallet)
Initialize Kamino SDK with connection and wallet
Fetch list of vaults using kamino.getVaults()
For each vault, get APY via vault.getApy()
Deposit: call vault.deposit(amount) with USDC or SOL
Automate via cron job or event trigger (e.g., when APY > threshold)
Charge fee via separate agent wallet or integrate with payment protocol
